automaticMaintenance.refresh: Every day at 12:37 and 22:37 UTC; connected quote collection daily in the US evening. Open pages check for new publications every minute.
automaticMaintenance.coverageGrowth: Up to four additional directory-verified company records per collection. Matching saved atlas evidence is reused with its original dates.
automaticMaintenance.dataProtection: Failed requests retain the last verified data, source identity and successful retrieval time
automaticMaintenance.requests: Conditional requests, cache reuse, host cooldowns and bounded retries
automaticMaintenance.quality: Financial and price checks, source coverage reports, and tracker integrity gate
automaticMaintenance.rendering: Bounded frame-time adaptation; reduced detail on slower devices
automaticMaintenance.codeChanges: Evidence-backed improvement proposals require validation and review
